notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. The only tower-specific source is the GA tower list (name, county, coordinates, list number). No build, design, staffing, fate or site source turned up after two WebSearches (Curry Decatur County GFC; Bainbridge tower removal), the list's own 'history' link (the Savannah Now article, read from the Wayback copy because the live URL returned HTTP 403), the GFC history page, or the firelookout.org 2013 and 2023 Georgia chapter reports; none names this tower. The DLG item dlg_vang_dec093 (ca. 1910 Bainbridge photo) shows a municipal fire alarm tower, not a forestry lookout, and is excluded. The list gives elevation (334) with no unit stated, so it is not used. Brief status, access and visit values are unsupported, so no facts keys are written. Next step if wanted: ask the GFC property division or Decatur County records whether a tower stood at these coordinates, and whether 'curry' names a road or community.
